title: Post-review fix cycle for Story 1.5 lane B (reason redaction blocker, precedence, artifact freshness, adapter honesty)
summary: One bounded fix cycle applying eight reviewer-defined items to the kit's dispatch adapter: replace a pattern-denylist redactor on worker free text with the kit's closed-vocabulary discipline (the blocker), never publish CONTINUATION_REQUIRED on a finished run, checkpoint artifact freshness, a claude usage adapter that reports only observed members and corroborates only on exact model keys, two prompt-paragraph sentences, an empty-signal rejection, contract and readiness-sweep hygiene, and the registry. Each item is pinned by the reviewer's reproduction scripts; frozen launch command texts stay byte-identical.
